summary: Peoples Bancorp Inc. filed an 8-K regarding its acquisition of Citizens National Corporation via a cash-and-stock merger. Citizens shareholders will receive 2.10 Peoples shares plus $8.00 cash per Citizens share (consideration mix not priced per share standalone; implied premium not stated). Boards of both companies unanimously approved. The merger involves Citizens merging into Peoples, then Citizens Bank into Peoples Bank. Closing requires Citizens shareholder approval, regulatory approvals from the Federal Reserve and Ohio Division of Financial Institutions, and customary conditions. Watch for regulatory timeline and shareholder vote risk.
